title: The Man and the Satyr
summary: A satyr gave shelter to a shivering traveler. The man blew on his cold fingers, explaining that warm breath heated his hands....
full_text:
A satyr gave shelter to a shivering traveler. The man blew on his cold fingers, explaining that warm breath heated his hands.

At dinner, the man blew on his hot porridge. "Why do you blow now?" asked the satyr.

"To cool my soup," replied the man.

The satyr drove him from the cave: "I will have no dealings with a creature who blows hot and cold with the same breath!"
moral: Beware the man who blows hot and cold with the same breath.
